name: Directorate Forward Command Citadel
description: A whole compound, not a single building -- first entry in a real shape library built directly from a user-drawn site polygon (map editor 'NERV HQ' site, 2026-08-23) rather than a reusable stamped-out template placed inside an arbitrary shape. The drawn polygon (a ~937m x 716m hooked peninsula) became the perimeter fence line itself (see the 'line' part below -- its footprint is that exact polygon, converted to local metres, not an approximation), and everything else was designed to fill it: a stepped command citadel + comms mast on the wide north lobe (the site's most commanding ground), an operations/quarters wing hugging the west edge, a paved yard crossing to a long Frame maintenance hangar laid out along the site's narrow eastern arm (the arm's own shape suggested a hangar strip rather than fighting it), and a seaward watchtower at the arm's tip covering the open-water approach. 1950s industrial-mecha, not sleek sci-fi (design/campaign-arc.md's tone doc): the citadel is a stepped concrete ziggurat, not a glass tower, and the Directorate itself is 'legitimate and procedural... not a hidden conspiracy' (data/factions/directorate.json) -- this reads as an overwhelmed civil-defence command post that grew past its original footprint, not a villain's secret lair. 'Directorate' is the real, already-established (if still unnamed) faction; nothing here invents new lore, just gives its forward operations a real building. Offshore by construction (the drawn site's centroid sits in open water after this session's island removals) -- no access road is expected until the causeway router exists (ideas/entries/offshore-construction.json phase b/c), same honest gap already documented on op-0005 and every other offshore site this session.
